patthana15.12:1.1: Nahetuṃ parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanahetu naparitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… (tīṇi).
patthana15.12:2.1: Hetuṃ mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu namahaggato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana15.12:3.1: Hetuṃ appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu naappamāṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
